flora: Oversized fuzzy fiddlehead (thick, coiled green spiral covered in dense, velvet-like brown hair)
Feather-like leaflet branch (a detailed section of a frond showing repeating dissected leaf patterns)
Fibrous trunk mass (macro close-up of a tree-fern stem showing a woven column of dark brown roots)
Spore cluster strip (neat rows of miniature raised circular capsules along a leaf blade edge)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; avoid thin, fragile lines; fiddleheads must look thick, fleshy, and stylized; clear texture contrast between the coarse brown fibrous trunk and the smooth, vibrant lime-green fronds.

visual_logic.composition: Quadrant composition: Top-Left: a giant, plush, tightly coiled brown-velvet fiddlehead; Top-Right: a detailed grid view of a repeating dissected leaf structure; Bottom-Left: a macro look at the woven, hair-like root trunk texture; Bottom-Right: the underside of a leaf blade highlighting the spore rows.
visual_logic.ground: A clean, dark charcoal floor composed of fine volcanic ash, emphasizing the bright green and rich brown specimens.
visual_logic.lighting: Clean, diffused daylight that clearly separates the fuzzy bronze details from the glossy green leaf tissues.
